item.title: Energy bills set to rise by £443 a year as price cap increases
item.body: Energy bills are set to rise by £443 a year as the energy price cap goes up again. The increase will leave the cap at its highest level in four years.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚡ Energy bills set to rise by £443 a year as price cap increases

Energy bills are set to rise by £443 a year as the energy price cap goes up again. The increase will leave the cap at its highest level in four years.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 25 November, 08:20
